text:
Priya L: putting this out early --- i'm experimenting with a "cost projections" sandbox in the console. idea: let teams run billing-neutral projections that show how changing routing/quota rules would change per-invocation token cost + cache split. curious if folks see major pitfalls.
Tom B: really useful for PMs. biggest risk is confusion between projected vs billed. must make the sandbox clearly non-billable and audit-only. :warning:
Iris M: agree. also think about how we compute cache attribution in projection mode. real infra uses KV hit-stats + per-request fingerprints; projection should use a deterministic heuristic so results are reproducible.
Charlie S: on deterministic heuristics 10: we could use a time-decay share: contribution = decay(t) * token_count, normalized across overlapping refs. decay(t) = exp(-lambda * age). choose lambda per-tenant?
Priya L: i like decay approach. default lambda=0.1/hr but slider in sandbox to tweak. UI will show "decay weight" as the main knob.
Tom B: for token-level math, frontend should only render pre-aggregated lines. API returns rows per-interval: model_sku, route_id, projected_cost, projected_cache_credit, attribution_confidence, explanation. sample row (concept):
```
model_sku: redwood-4b
route_id: web-search
projected_cost: 0.0029
projected_cache_credit: 0.0011
attribution_confidence: medium
explanation: "split by decay-weight=0.1, overlap_count=2"
```
Iris M: add a "shadow_billing_id" tag so we can reconcile later. Also keep raw_refs (trace ids) but hide them behind an "ops" role.
Priya L: API shape i'm proposing: `/projections/run?tenant=acme&window=6h&policy=sticky-vs-cost-aware&decay=0.1&sampling=0.1`. returns projection_id + stable result url. Pollable. anyone object to query params?
Charlie S: fine. note: sampling param should be default 0.01 for large tenants to limit compute. add a note in API: we downsample >100rps.
Tom B: rollout UX: show a banner on the cost card when projection is active: "Preview mode - not billed". Provide export to CSV and an "apply to real world" button that only creates a PR-like proposal, not change infra.
Iris M: for quotas: projections can show hypothetical quota consumption but must not alter live quota. important to prevent confusion where an engineer thinks a projection changed production limits.
Priya L: under the hood: projection pipeline will replay sampled traces through a routing-simulator, then run the attribution algorithm. compute cost using per-model unit prices and a configurable quantization factor to simulate different model variants.
Charlie S: suggest we expose a "quantization scenario" toggle e.g., int8 vs fp16 so teams can see effect of cheaper model variants on unit economics.
Tom B: great idea. also add a small "what-if routing" dropdown: sticky, cost-aware, latency-priority. UI should show delta sparkline per route and per-model.
Iris M: monitoring: create a projection-audit index. every run writes a compact snapshot: projection_id, params, total_projected_cost, total_projected_cache_credit, seed_hash. seed_hash ensures runs with same seed are comparable.
Priya L: reconciliation: schedule weekly job to compare projection samples against actuals for tenants who opt in to "shadow billing". trigger an alert if deviation > 5% for two consecutive weeks.
Tom B: security: ensure projection API cannot be used to exfiltrate trace-level refs. clamp raw_refs behind feature flag and ops role.
Charlie S: implementation note: make the routing-simulator deterministic using fixed RNG seed passed in the API. include seed in returned metadata.
Iris M: UX nit: when attribution_confidence=low, show a short explanation and a link to "how attribution works" doc. low-conf should also show contributing factors (overlap_count, sample_rate).
Priya L: agreed. final Q: do we allow tenants to save projection presets? e.g., "Canary-50pct-cost-aware". could be helpful for repeated runs.
Tom B: yes, but store them as per-user saved presets not global to tenant, to avoid accidental policy changes.
OpsBot: build queued -> projections-sim:v1.0.0 :gear: ETA 8m
Priya L: thanks team. i'll draft a short RFC and a prototype wireframe. will post link here when ready.
Tom B: ping me for the CSV schema so billing can ingest.
Charlie S: dropping sim results in ~24h.
OpsBot: build successful -> projections-sim:v1.0.0 :white_check_mark:
